title: Comparing Entering Customer Cash Receipts in Dynamics SL to Dynamics 365 Business Central

chapters.title: Cash Receipts Journal in Business Central

features.name: Cash Receipts Journal
features.description: A journal in Business Central for recording customer payments where users can select a customer, enter payment amount, and apply it to specific invoices through a lookup feature.

features.name: Customer Register Payments Window
features.description: An alternative window in Business Central that displays all outstanding invoices for all customers, allowing users to filter by customer and select multiple invoices to post as a lump sum payment.

features.name: Apply to Documents Lookup
features.description: A lookup feature in the cash receipts journal that allows users to view and select outstanding invoices for a customer, with automatic population of payment amounts.

quotes.text: To create customer payments in Business Central, we'll select the search icon and enter in the cash receipts journals.

quotes.text: In addition to cash receipts journals, you can also use the customer register payments window to record customer payments.
quotes.why_it_matters: Indicates there are multiple approaches available for recording customer payments.

quotes.text: If the customer was sending a payment for more than one invoice, I can select multiple invoices
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows flexibility for handling payments covering multiple invoices.

quotes.text: Business Central provides a simple and easy way to record customer payments, allowing for a more streamlined cash receipt process.
quotes.why_it_matters: Characterizes the overall design philosophy and benefits of the Business Central payment recording approach.
